Demand remains good ahead of Diwali, with higher-quality apples commanding good prices.

items.title: India's October Gross GST collections jump 22.9% to Rs 2.31 lakh crore
items.summary: India's gross GST collection reached Rs 2.31 lakh crore in October, representing a 22.9% increase from last year. The gross GST collected for the April-October period totaled Rs 14.78 lakh crore, showing a 13.2% growth year-on-year. Maharashtra recorded the highest revenue for October at Rs 35,150 crore, followed by Karnataka and Gujarat. Some states, including Sikkim and Ladakh, experienced significant declines in GST collections during the month.

items.title: GST reforms: Easier registration for small e-commerce sellers, faster refunds to take effect Nov 1

Automatic sanctioning of full refund claims for excess balance in electronic cash ledgers will expedite the refund process. Flexibility in post-supply discount taxation will support industries with volume-based incentives and trade schemes.

items.title: India extends cotton import duty exemption till December 31
items.summary: The Indian government has extended the customs duty exemption on cotton imports to December 31. This decision aims to support the textile industry by ensuring adequate raw material availability. The waiver allows greater flexibility for manufacturers to source inputs at reduced costs. Domestic cotton prices have remained firm due to production concerns, prompting this extension. The move is expected to strengthen Indian textiles in both domestic and international markets.
